name: project-personal-website
description: Personal website at jaredhoward.com — SvelteKit static site deployed to GitHub Pages.

scripts.//-- dev --: SvelteKit dev server (http://localhost:7777) and a static preview (http://localhost:8888) of the built site.
scripts.//-- build --: Production static build → ./build (adapter-static, full prerender). This is exactly what deploy.yml uploads to GitHub Pages.
scripts.//-- check --: Type + Svelte diagnostics. svelte-kit sync first so generated types (.svelte-kit/) exist.
scripts.//-- test --: Vitest unit suite; test:scripts validates this file's script layout (scripts/check_root_scripts.mjs).
